headline: Denied. A hold rule applies, but even with an approval no rule would allow this.

who.name: Mary
who.text: Mary, in the group analysts, with the scope tools:invoke. Dot is acting for Mary. Signed in with a mock sign-in (persona).

asked.attendedText: unattended: Dot made the call for Mary (the token carries an agent)
asked.text: book_fare (booking app), amount 2400. Unattended: Dot made the call for Mary. Approvals so far: 0. Tool schema: matches the approved version.

why: The rule “Fares over 1000 need a second pair of eyes” (s01-hold-large-fare) would hold this for Priya, but with an approval recorded no allow rule covers the request either, so there is nothing for an approval to unlock.

decidedBy.reason: Fares over 1000 need a second pair of eyes
decidedBy.does: Holds unattended calls to the book_fare tool when an amount is given and the amount is over 1000, until Priya approves. It stops applying once someone has approved the call.

rules.reason: Fares over 1000 need a second pair of eyes
rules.statusText: Would hold it, but the call is denied anyway
because: the call is unattended (Dot acts for Mary)
rules.oneLine: Holds unattended calls to the book_fare tool when an amount is given and the amount is over 1000, until Priya approves. It stops applying once someone has approved the call.

rules.reason: Tool schema changed since it was approved
because: the tool still matches the version that was approved
rules.oneLine: Blocks any call to any tool when the tool's description or schema has changed since it was approved.

rules.reason: Hard cap: no booking over 10000 for anyone
rules.oneLine: Blocks calls (attended or unattended) to the book_fare tool when an amount is given and the amount is over 10000.

because: Mary is not in the travel-agents group
rules.oneLine: Lets people in the travel-agents group make calls (attended or unattended) to tools in the booking app.

rules.reason: Analysts may use Search and Ticketing
because: this rule is about the search and ticketing apps, not the booking app
rules.oneLine: Lets people in the analysts group make attended calls to tools in the search or ticketing app.

rules.reason: Payments is for finance, with the payments:write scope
because: this rule is about the payments app, not the booking app
rules.oneLine: Lets people in the finance group make attended calls to tools in the payments app when the token has the payments:write scope.

change.text: Even approved, nothing allows it. “Travel agents may book fares” (s23-permit-travel-agents) would cover it if Mary were in the travel-agents group, and the call would then be held for Priya to approve.

items.text: Mary were in the travel-agents group

approval.text: Priya could approve it, but the rules would still deny it afterwards, so no approval request is opened.

notes: Rules look at the person's groups. The agent's own groups are not used.

technical.reason: Fares over 1000 need a second pair of eyes
